messages.content:
Read one passage of a document about machines at work (law, manual, guidance, internal guideline,
plant record) and write down the important facts it states.

Answer with one line per fact, fields separated by " | ", nothing else, no header, no code fence:
subject | predicate | object | condition | quote
- predicate: a short camelCase verb phrase of your choice.
- condition: any condition or exception, or "" if none.
- quote: the words of the passage the fact comes from.
At most 12 facts. If the passage states nothing important, answer with the single word NONE.

Passage: REG, Art. 6(6)

Article 6 Categories of machinery and related products listed in Annex I subject to relevant conformity assessment procedures. 6. The data and information referred to in paragraph 5, points (a) to (d), shall be provided by Member States in accordance with paragraph 9.

response.text: data and information referred to in Article 6(5)(a) to (d) | shallBeProvidedBy | Member States | in accordance with paragraph 9 | The data and information referred to in paragraph 5, points (a) to (d), shall be provided by Member States in accordance with paragraph 9.
